openai/codex ↗ 3 releases · 1 stable · 2 prerelease
rust-v0.164.0-alpha.10.164.0-alpha.1 Prerelease2026-10-16T14:49:55Z

Release 0.164.0-alpha.1

View release →

rust-v0.163.00.163.0 Stable2026-10-15T21:30:38Z

New Features

  • Open /config to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)
  • Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)
  • Configure a leader key in /keymap. The default is Ctrl+X, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to F9. (#52273)
  • Restart a managed background server from /daemon. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)
  • Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)
  • Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. codex exec can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

Bug Fixes

  • Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
  • The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate Host headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)
  • Return to an existing side conversation with /side after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)
  • On Windows, Ctrl+V and Shift+Insert paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)
  • Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
  • codex exec no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

Documentation

  • Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
  • Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

Chores

  • Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched zsh. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
  • Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v4.0.14CC Switch v4.0.14 Stable2026-10-16T12:35:32Z

CC Switch v4.0.14

本版本为用量统计面板增加了大量自定义选项：用量页新增「设置」页签，金额可以换成人民币、欧元、日元等币种显示（汇率可以自己改），侧栏「今日」可以选显示金额、Token、请求数或缓存命中率，请求日志可以选显示哪些列，并新增缓存写入、命中率、总耗时和状态码四列；再打开用量页时，会回到上次看的页签、时间范围和图表指标。Claude Code 卡片上的「打开终端」会先说明这个目录是做什么用的，并记住最近用过的目录。还修复了 Codex 经路由连接 Gemini 时第二轮工具调用报 400、路由模式下 Codex 的重试次数设置失效、超过 128 MiB 的 Skills 仓库装不上、含大写字母的自定义定价不生效、Hermes 开发版一直提示有新版本、故障转移队列调整顺序没反应等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 v4.0 发布说明。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

用量金额可以换成其他币种显示。 用量页原来的「定价」页签改为「设置」，上面是新的「显示」区，下面仍是定价配置。在「币种」里可以选美元（默认）、人民币、欧元、日元、新台币、土耳其里拉，「汇率」预填了参考值，可以自己改。费用仍按美元记录，只在显示时换算，悬停可以看到美元原值；图表先换算再画，坐标轴刻度仍是整数。换算后的金额最多保留两位小数（日元少两位），金额较大时按千分位分隔。

侧栏「今日」可以选显示什么。 侧栏用量那一行原来固定显示今日金额，现在可以在「侧栏「今日」」里选金额、Token、请求数、缓存命中率，最多选两项，也可以都不选、不显示。名字不再被后面的数字挤窄；选了两项时，这一行只显示两个数字，完整说明放在悬停提示里。

请求日志可以选显示哪些列。 在「请求日志的列」里勾选要显示的列，新增四列，默认都不显示：

  • 缓存写入：写进缓存的 Token 数。Codex、Gemini、Grok 不报告这个数，显示「—」并在悬停时说明。
  • 命中率：每条请求的缓存命中率（#7298），算法和总命中率相同；向下取到一位小数，接近全中也不会显示成 100%。
  • 总耗时：整个流式响应的时长；从会话日志估算的值前面带「≈」。
  • 状态码：显示这一列时，时间旁边的错误标记就不再显示。

列多时表格可以左右滚动，不再把每一列挤窄。

用量页记住上次的视图。 再打开用量页时，会回到上次看的页签、预设时间范围和趋势图、热力图的指标。自定义的日期范围不会覆盖记住的预设范围，应用、供应商、模型筛选不保留。

「打开终端」先说明再选目录。 以前点 Claude Code 卡片上的「打开终端」会直接弹出系统的选目录窗口，看不出这个目录是做什么的。现在先弹出「在哪个目录打开终端？」，说明会在你选的目录里打开终端，并用这张卡的配置启动 Claude Code，一般选项目文件夹。上次成功打开的目录会自动填上，「最近用过」里最多列出五个目录，点一下就能选，也可以移除。卡片有自己的地址和 Key 时，还会说明这个终端是隔离的：之后在 CC Switch 里切换供应商不会影响它。

定价： 新增 Gemini 4 Argon 的内置价格（#8356），是 2026-11-30 前的介绍价；已经记成 0 的历史请求会在启动时重新计价。

改进

Claude Desktop 的 1M 模型只显示一行。 Desktop 以前会把每个声明了 1M 的模型列两次：普通的一行，加一行「1M 上下文」。现在只留普通的一行，选中后仍按 1M 窗口用。路由和聚合模式下，下次启动 CC Switch 或切换模式后生效；直连模式下，下次切换供应商或保存这张卡后生效。

路由时不能删除直连那家，现在会说明原因。 路由或聚合模式下，直连指向的那张卡不能删除，因为退出路由后要回到它（#8277）。以前提示写的是「正在用的这家不能删除」，而路由页上这张卡并没有标成正在使用，让人摸不着头脑。现在提示会写明原因，以及先在直连页对别家点「回到直连并使用」再删除。

连接上游失败时，日志写明具体原因。 以前路由转发失败只记「error sending request」这类笼统的话，分不出是域名解析、连接被拒、TLS 还是连接被重置（#8416）。现在日志会带上底层原因，方便判断多家同时失败是不是同一条网络出了问题；记录前会先去掉 URL，查询参数里的 Key 不会进日志。

预设： 硅基流动国内站的 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Hermes、OpenClaw 预设改用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（原来的 MiniMax-M2.5 已下线）；TokenFactory 在中文界面显示为「词元工厂」；Pi 换成 pi.dev 新的三色图标。

修复

  • Codex 经路由连接 Gemini 时，第二轮工具调用报 400「missing a thought_signature」（#8336）。Gemini 会在工具调用里返回一个签名，并要求下一轮原样带回，CC Switch 的格式转换把它丢了。现在会保存并带回；CC Switch 在一轮工具调用中途重启、签名丢失时，按 Gemini 文档的做法补一个占位签名，不再报错。其他上游不受影响。
  • 路由模式下，Codex 配置里的重试次数不生效（#8265）。进入路由后，供应商设置的 stream_max_retries、request_max_retries、stream_idle_timeout_ms 会被丢掉，比如设成 50 次的重试又回到 Codex 默认的 5 次。现在会保留。
  • 超过 128 MiB 的 Skills 仓库装不上，还被误报成解压超限（#8421）。仓库压缩包以前整个读进内存，上限 128 MiB；现在边下载边写进临时文件，上限提高到和解压一致的 512 MiB，下载超限时单独提示。
  • 含大写字母的自定义模型定价不生效，成本一直是 0（#8413）。例如按界面显示名填的 GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3。现在查价不区分大小写，新请求和保存后的历史回填都能算上。
  • OpenCode 会话中工具调用多的轮次，估算速度偏低（#8402）。耗时以前算到工具执行完，现在算到模型输出结束。
  • OpenCode 一键导入的两个问题：导入成功后卡片的「已添加」状态不及时更新（#8380）；名字是中文的供应商导入后在编辑页保存不了（#8379）。
  • Hermes 开发版一直提示有新版本（#8394）。0.22.1+238.g<sha> 这类开发版版本号以前被当成正式版 0.22.1 去比较，hermes update 之后提示也不消失。现在开发版不再提示。
  • WSL 里装了但运行报错的工具，被显示成「未安装」（#8167）。以前输出里只要有「not found」就判为未安装，例如「module not found」；现在只认 shell 的「找不到命令」。
  • Codex 父会话里有一条乱码记录时，子代理用量一直统计不上（#8360）。现在跳过这条记录，其余正常统计。
  • 故障转移队列调整顺序后没变化，却提示成功（#8297）。队列里有两家排序值相同，或者新加的供应商没有排序值时，上移下移会写成相同的值。现在调整后的顺序一定会生效。
  • Windows 上同一个项目因为盘符大小写不同，在会话管理里被拆成两组（#8233）。例如 D:\projects\demo 和 d:\projects\demo。现在会合成一组。
  • OpenClaw 在配置 JSON 里改了请求头后，「发送 User-Agent」开关不跟着变（#8256）。

升级说明

数据库结构没有变化，仍然是 20。

  • 用量页的「定价」页签移到了「设置」里；币种、侧栏「今日」和请求日志列的设置只保存在本机，不随云同步。
  • Claude Desktop 直连模式下，1M 模型的两行要等下次切换供应商或保存这张卡后才合成一行。
  • Gemini 4 Argon 的内置价格是 2026-11-30 前的介绍价，之后的正式价会在下一次价格更新里调整。

致谢

感谢 @Vincebye（含大写字母的自定义定价）、@xianshang33（OpenCode 速度估算）、@HaiYangBG1（OpenCode 一键导入的两个问题）、@Tsuki-hash（Hermes 开发版误报新版本）、@Adonis0123（WSL 工具检测）、@Carl723000（Codex 父会话乱码记录）、@Besty0728（Gemini 4 Argon 定价）的贡献。

感谢 @maq233、@CR547、@zqbake、@Hybangbang、@zhang3776813、@zhangyudi-01、@zsp1029、@hulkbig、@tarnish233 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。

v4.0.13CC Switch v4.0.13 Stable2026-10-15T16:32:11Z

CC Switch v4.0.13

本版本让 Claude Desktop 和 Claude Code、Codex 一样，可以在页面顶部选择直连、路由、聚合三种模式：路由模式下模型列表跟着路由那家走，聚合模式下可以把多家供应商的模型同时放进 Desktop 的模型列表。Codex 新增「自动审批模型」，开了自动审批（Approve for me）的第三方供应商不再请求一个大多数中转都没有的模型而报 404；聚合模式下还可以单独指定子代理用哪个模型和推理强度。切回直连前改为先弹确认框，写明会连到哪家、改哪个文件。GPT 系列模型的上下文窗口统一封顶 272K，不再因为窗口写大了而迟迟不压缩、最后被上游拒绝。Windows 便携版的更新按钮现在直接下载对应的压缩包。Claude Code 的 Haiku 档也能声明 1M 上下文，模型本身是 1M 窗口的预设改为默认勾上 1M。还修复了 Codex 保存配置时报「duplicate key」、路由模式下 Codex 远程压缩失效、装了很多 fnm 版本时切换模式卡住几分钟、Windows 11 上窗口卡死等问题。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 v4.0 发布说明。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

Claude Desktop：直连、路由、聚合三选一。 以前 Claude Desktop 由每张卡片自己决定是直连还是走模型映射，要不要启动映射服务也是单独的开关。现在它和 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Grok Build 用同一套模式面板，在页面顶部选择：

  • 直连：把供应商的地址和 Key 直接写进 Desktop 的配置，请求不经过 CC Switch。需要模型映射的卡片不能直连，会提示先开始路由。
  • 路由：Desktop 的请求经本机 CC Switch 转发给路由那家，模型列表换成路由那家映射表里的模型。之后切换路由那家时，只有模型列表变了才会改写 Desktop 的配置文件。
  • 聚合：默认那家的模型排在前面，其他加入聚合的供应商的模型以「供应商 / 模型」的名字一起出现在 Desktop 的模型列表里，选哪个就发给哪家，最多 200 个。

Desktop 只在启动时读配置，所以每次换模式、换路由那家或增减聚合成员之后，都要重启 Desktop 才生效，界面会逐一提示。Desktop 的路由没有故障转移；退出 CC Switch 时 Desktop 的配置保持不变，要继续用路由或聚合，CC Switch 需要保持运行。以前用模型映射卡的，升级后会自动进入路由模式，见文末升级说明。

Codex：自动审批可以换一个模型。 Codex 开了自动审批（Approve for me）后，每次沙箱提权都会交给一个审批模型判断能不能放行，而且发给主对话的同一家。第三方卡片以前没法选这个模型：没有模型列表时，Codex 会向供应商请求官方的 codex-auto-review，大多数中转都不认，直接报 404；有模型列表时则由主模型自己审批（#8015、#5903、#3855）。

  • 直连和路由：Codex 卡片新增「自动审批模型」，可以从这张卡的模型列表里选一个。官方卡片不显示这一项；卡片没有模型列表时这一项不可选，并说明原因。
  • 聚合：在聚合页签的「聚合设置」里选，可以选聚合里别家的模型，让审批发给另一家供应商。
  • 改完需要重启 Codex。

Codex 聚合模式：子代理可以用单独的模型。 聚合模式以前会去掉 [agents] 里的子代理模型，子代理只能跟随主模型（#8286）。现在「让 Codex 使用聚合模式？」确认框和新的「聚合设置」里都可以选子代理模型和子代理推理强度。不用重启 Codex，新开的对话就会生效。选的模型如果已经不在聚合里（成员被移除，或者那家成了默认），子代理会暂时跟随主模型，加回来后自动恢复。

Claude Code：Haiku 档也能声明 1M。 以前「模型映射」里只有 Sonnet、Opus、Fable 和子代理几行能勾「声明支持 1M」，因为过去 Haiku 模型都没有 1M 窗口。现在 Haiku 档常常指向第三方模型，而 Claude Code 对不以 claude- 开头的模型名一律按 200K 窗口算，不勾就会提前压缩。现在每一行都能勾 1M。路由模式不受影响：路由用的 Haiku 别名本来就按 1M 算。

预设： 新增 TokenFactory、Modelflare。

Windows 便携版：更新按钮直接下载压缩包。 便携版启动时本来就会检查更新，但点「更新到 vX」只是打开发布页，要在几十个文件里自己找对应的压缩包（#8300）。现在会直接下载与当前架构（x64 / ARM64）对应的便携版压缩包，解压后覆盖原来的 cc-switch.exe 即可；配置和数据保存在用户目录下的 .cc-switch，不会因覆盖而丢失。为了避免被杀毒软件拦截，CC Switch 不会自己替换自己的程序文件。

改进

切回直连前先确认。 进入路由或聚合时本来就有确认框，切回直连却是点了立即生效，只在提示里给一个容易错过的「撤销」。现在「回到直连」按钮、卡片上的「回到直连并使用」，以及路由服务停止时的提示，都会先弹确认框，写明客户端会直接连接哪家、哪个文件里的地址和密钥会被改回去；从路由切回时说明路由目标、故障转移队列和设置都会保留，从聚合切回时说明哪些模型会从 /model 里消失。出错直接显示在确认框里，「撤销」去掉了。

Codex：「聚合模式下子 agent 用经典工具」默认打开。 主代理和子代理不在同一家时，Codex 新版的子 agent 工具会把任务加密，只有主代理那家解得开，子代理收不到任务（#8253）。这个开关从设置页挪进「聚合设置」，改为默认打开。

GPT 模型的上下文窗口封顶 272K。 models.dev 上 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 系列写的是 OpenAI API 的 105 万窗口，但很多中转是用 ChatGPT 订阅转发的，订阅的上限是 272K，而 CC Switch 从地址上分不出是哪一种。窗口写大了，客户端会一直不压缩，直到上游拒绝请求、这一轮直接失败；写小了只是早一点压缩。现在添加供应商时自动补全的 GPT 窗口一律不超过 272K，Hermes、OpenClaw、OpenCode、Pi、Codex 预设里的 GPT 窗口也一起下调；Claude Code 里用 ChatGPT 订阅的「Codex」预设从 372K 改为 272K。比 272K 小的窗口不变。

模型本身是 1M 窗口的预设，默认勾上 1M。 Claude Code 对不认识的模型名按 200K 窗口算，GLM-5.3、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4、Qwen3.8、MiniMax-M3、MiMo、LongCat 等 1M 模型的 23 个预设以前没有声明，直连时到 200K 左右就开始自动压缩。现在这些预设里 1M 模型的那几档都默认勾上「声明支持 1M」；Kimi For Coding 有意保持 256K 的压缩窗口，不变。Claude Desktop 里同样模型的 12 个预设，以及转发 Claude Sonnet 5、Opus 5 的 50 个预设，也在模型列表里声明 1M；Claude Haiku 4.x 只有 200K 窗口，以前被一些预设误标成 1M，现在改正。

修复

  • Codex 保存配置时报「duplicate key custom in table model_providers」（#8271）。config.toml 里供应商表头带引号（[model_providers."custom"]）时认不出来，保存时又加了一张同名的表。现在双引号、单引号、带空格的写法都能认出来。
  • 路由或聚合模式下，Codex 的远程压缩失效（#8338）。进入路由或聚合、保存当前供应商或重启 CC Switch 后，供应商开的远程压缩设置会丢掉，Codex 改用本地摘要压缩，带搜索记录的会话可能报 response protection is unavailable。现在会保留路由那家的压缩设置。
  • 经路由转换 OpenAI Chat 上游时，回复结束后还可能再收到一条错误（#8281）。上游发完 [DONE] 后断开连接，CC Switch 会在正常结束之后再补一个错误，或者把之后的内容继续转发出去。现在收到 [DONE] 就结束。
  • OpenCode 会话的耗时一直是 0、速度列为空（#6326）。现在按每条消息的开始和完成时间计算耗时，能显示估算速度。
  • Codex 分支对话翻页后的用量一直不入账（#8161）。分支对话翻页生成的续写文件被当成新派生的子会话，一直等不到父会话写到那个时刻。现在能认出这是分支对话自己的续写。
  • 用 fnm 装了很多 Node 版本时，切换模式卡住几分钟（#8313）。查找命令行工具时去重的写法随路径数平方增长，fnm 的 multishell 目录一多就很慢；现在路径很多时也只要几十毫秒。
  • Windows 11 上窗口卡死、主线程持续高占用（#8321、#8324）。问题出在 WebView2 处理原生拖拽区域时。Windows 上不再使用原生拖拽区域，拖动和双击最大化改用应用自己的处理，标题栏的用法不变。
  • Claude Code 聚合模式下，Haiku 档只有 200K 窗口。聚合模式会去掉 Haiku 档的 1M 声明，而聚合模型名不以 claude- 开头，Claude Code 就按 200K 算。现在 Haiku 档和其他档一样保留 1M 声明。
  • Codex 聚合模式换默认供应商时，预览把原来的默认那家算成 0 个模型。默认那家本身不发布聚合模型，但换走之后它的模型会全部加进聚合；现在预览显示的是换走之后的数量。

升级说明

数据库结构没有变化，仍然是 20。

  • Claude Desktop 当前用的是模型映射卡的，首次启动会自动切到路由模式、路由到这张卡，直连那边改为官方。重启 Claude Desktop 后生效。
  • Codex 的「聚合模式下子 agent 用经典工具」改为默认打开，以前关掉的不会保留；需要关闭的话在「聚合设置」里重新关掉。
  • GPT 窗口封顶只影响新添加的供应商和新补全的模型参数，已添加的卡片保持原来的窗口。
  • 改了自动审批模型后要重启 Codex。
  • 1M 相关的预设改动只影响新添加的供应商；已添加的卡片可以在「模型映射」里自己勾上「声明支持 1M」。

致谢

感谢 @HEOJUNFO（Codex 带引号的供应商表头）、@zqtqzy（路由模式下的 Codex 远程压缩）、@xue-ding-e（Chat 流在 [DONE] 处结束）、@zhengkaics 和 @SailingLoong（OpenCode 会话耗时）、@Lingbou（Codex 分支对话翻页用量）、@hulkbig（fnm 路径去重）、@funkpopo（Windows 窗口卡死）的贡献。

感谢 @zhangchuanqiang-cloud、@SRQuan、@vvvss7992、@obsidian0215、@wangding0610、@XinwangTao、@RRRRSH、@YwaQ96、@Tison6、@haveqqq、@cc10143、@KDB-Wind 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。

thedotmack/claude-mem ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v13.40.0 Stable2026-10-16T12:25:04Z

What's new

TeamBrain from the terminal

  • npx claude-mem teambrain join <invite-link> connects this install to a TeamBrain team using the same device-code sign-in as install. You approve the device in the browser, then choose which projects to share. Also: teambrain status, teambrain share, teambrain leave, teambrain start. (#4815)
  • Members who join with a team seat keep their own local observer — joining never switches your observer provider.
  • When an install belongs to a team, SessionStart adds a short team brief: open collisions in this project, recent plans and decisions, who else is active, and items delegated to you. Agents also get read-only team_brief and team_search MCP tools. Installs that are not in a team see no change.

Work-state sync

  • The agent's work-state tracker (work_state_write / work_state_read) now syncs to the cloud as a work_state content kind, for accounts where the sync server enables it. Until then rows wait locally — they are never dropped. Devices that skipped work-state ops on older builds apply them once after upgrading. (#4569)

Also new

  • The Claude observer can batch queued events (opt-in). (#4793)
  • Viewer: the NOTES summary section has its own icon (#4776); long prompts clamp behind a "Show more" disclosure (#4765).

Fixes

  • Codex: bundle Zod so cached hooks load without node_modules (#4771); reject a host root without its dependencies in the hook resolver (#4766); finish teardown before removing the private runtime (#4792).
  • Search: reject an unparseable dateStart/dateEnd with 400 INVALID_DATE (#4786); validate limit/offset with 400 INVALID_PAGINATION (#4787); make the implicit 90-day recency window configurable (#4773).
  • Privacy: strip nested and overlapping memory tags (#4761); opt-in generic credential patterns, with the redaction settings documented (#4762).
  • Ingest: register an unknown project when hook payloads have no cwd (#4774); apply CLAUDE_MEM_SKIP_BASH_PATTERNS to the PowerShell tool (#4756).
  • Hooks: skip SessionEnd for sessions that are never tracked (#4780); fix hook spool delivery to remote workers (#4626).
  • Worker: spare a silent worker whose liveness heartbeat is fresh, for a bounded time (#4794).
  • Projects: promote a merged-from project to a read key only for whole-project merges (#4789).
  • Context files: keep CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md symlinks when refreshing context (#4784).
  • Exclusions: a trailing /** pattern also excludes the directory itself (#4785).
  • Cursor: preserve your own hooks.json entries on install/uninstall (#4783).
  • Logger: keep the day log open instead of re-opening it per line (#4791).
  • Launcher: ad-hoc re-sign the compiled binary on macOS before the protocol probe (#4781).
  • CLI: show help for install, update, uninstall and other action verbs instead of running them (#4767).
  • DSH: keep every table's header when collapsing duplicate rows (#4790).
  • Tree-sitter: verify the CLI loads, not just that it exists (#4777).
  • Build: leave posthog-node's optional OpenTelemetry import unresolved (#4795).

Upgrade notes

  • The local database schema moves to v67 on first open. Older builds refuse a database a newer build has opened (no downgrade), so update every install that shares ~/.claude-mem.
  • If work-state sync is enabled for your account, your existing work-state history uploads once.
  • Using claude-mem on more than one machine? Update all of them — builds older than v13.29.0 cannot skip sync content they don't recognize.

crynta/terax-ai ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.9.0Terax v0.9.0 Stable2026-10-16T11:55:46Z

Terax 0.9.0 introduces a new Ghostty-powered + WebGPU terminal and a broad pass on responsiveness and resource use.

  • Lower idle CPU use and less memory growth when switching tabs, desktops, and windows.
  • Smoother window and split resizing, with fewer redraw artifacts and duplicated prompts.
  • Pixel-aligned text and seamless box-drawing, braille, and Powerline glyphs.
  • More efficient terminal output, background tasks, file watching, and startup loading.
  • More reliable AI conversation storage and cancellation, plus security hardening around terminal transport and network requests.
  • Explorer file paste from the OS clipboard, multi-select operations, and faster file search.
  • Bundled CLI file opening, nested-repository Git support, editor shortcut improvements, and refined agent notifications and window styling.

Downloads include macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows, and Linux packages. Windows installations without WebView2 need an internet connection to install its runtime.

trycua/cua ↗ 6 releases · 3 stable · 3 prerelease
cua-driver-rs-v0.36.0cua-driver-rs: v0.36.0 Prerelease2026-10-16T08:25:43Z

Cua Driver 0.36.0

This release makes background work on macOS more reliable. The driver does more without touching your windows, your keyboard focus or your pointer.

What's new

  • Background typing into LibreOffice. Documents and spreadsheets take keystrokes while you work in another app.
  • Chrome's first read of a background window now includes the page. You no longer get an empty tree on the first call.
  • Background drag. Drags work in native apps and on web pages. Electron windows refuse a background drag in this release and offer a foreground drag instead.
  • Background menu commands. Menu and format controls work without bringing the app forward.
  • Reading pages on another Space. You can read a page without switching Spaces.
  • Dropdowns no longer raise the window.
  • No focus bounce after background clicks. Your app keeps focus.
  • A clear error when you run the bare binary. The driver now says so and asks you to run the app bundle (CuaDriver.app), which it needs for a WindowServer connection. health_report has a new windowserver_connection check.
  • Updated skill guidance for agents.

Changes

Features

  • publish isolated browser session lifetime in browser_prepare. (#5183) Thanks @iflaqbhat.
  • background drag on macOS (CUA-1207). (#5309)

Fixes

  • advertise coordinate scrolling support. (#5149) Thanks @Iflaqbhat; reported by @amplogik.
  • let CUA_LOG=info and debug raise the log level. (#5173) Thanks @Ed-Key.
  • type long Linux text in spare-keycode batches. (#5168) Thanks @CMGS.
  • stop worker and embedded processes launching Orca on GNOME. (#5179) Thanks @methanoya.
  • drain autoreleased objects on SCK capture workers. (#5170) Thanks @Irfanwani.
  • report every layer when list_windows is given a pid. (#5162) Thanks @bitomule.
  • wait for the client before restoring a borrowed keycode. (#5172) Thanks @CMGS.
  • build macOS fixtures for the host architecture. (#5202) Thanks @loonghao.
  • list window rows in list_windows text content. (#5211) Thanks @Irfanwani.
  • print actionable PATH install hints. (#5219) Thanks @Iflaqbhat.
  • report actual browser delivery mode in public results. (#5222)
  • refuse unconfirmed macOS Electron scrolls. (#5251) Thanks @SDSLeon.
  • honor --pid-file in cua-driver status. (#5246) Thanks @methanoya.
  • skip web content during Chrome consent scans. (#5216) Thanks @Iflaqbhat.
  • report Linux and Windows permissions status instead of "not granted". (#5237) Thanks @RitikaxG.
  • say why a Windows desktop can't be captured (locked, RDP disconnected) (CUA-1727). (#5266)
  • stop a batched text before rebinding keycodes the client has not confirmed reading. (#5244) Thanks @CMGS.
  • background keyboard into editor surfaces and multi-window apps (CUA-1767). (#5306)
  • background menu/format controls and page reads on another Space (CUA-1768, CUA-1769). (#5307)
  • make the addressed LibreOffice window key without activating (CUA-1767). (#5319)
  • wait for Chrome web content on first read; point background browser_prepare refusals to the AX route (CUA-1766). (#5305)
  • refuse background drags in Electron windows and fix the AppKit drag cell. (#5335)
  • stop background actions from raising Chrome or re-activating the user's app (CUA-1309, CUA-1791). (#5334)
  • resolve launch_app to the app window, not a launcher splash. (#5342) Thanks @abonneth.
  • fail loudly when the unbundled daemon has no WindowServer connection (CUA-1777). (#5333)
  • keep the current tab's page out of the Chrome setup proof. (#5343) Thanks @abonneth.

Contributors

Thanks to @abonneth, @amplogik, @bitomule, @CMGS, @Ed-Key, @Iflaqbhat, @Irfanwani, @loonghao, @methanoya, @RitikaxG, @SDSLeon for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

Imbad0202/academic-research-skills ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v3.23.1v3.23.1 — Write-scope guard repairs, RFC 4180 CSV reading in sr-screener, and Gemini 4 Argon as a provisional verifier Stable2026-10-16T08:00:43Z

Repairs and model currency; no new skill, and no accuracy or performance claim: v3.23.1 closes two write-scope guard paths that let writes through without a check, one for plugin-dispatched agents and one for Windows timeout.exe (#972), and the docs now state where the fence engages (#974). sr-screener reads CSV exports by RFC 4180 quoting instead of quote rules guessed from a sample (#979). Gemini 4 Argon is listed as a provisional Google verifier and the recommended Google id; gemini-3.1-pro-preview stays validated (#980). The routing core states that a mid-message [direct-mode] token is not the escape hatch (#892); in a smoke test on a plugin install, Claude Fable 5.1 still honored the token in 3 of 6 sessions (6 of 6 before), so the acceptance rule is not met and #892 stays open. Smaller lint and Windows repairs come from outside contributors (#956, #963, #965, #977), and THIRD_PARTY.md lists md-to-word (#969).

Changed

  • Gemini 4 Argon (gemini-4-argon) is listed as a provisional Google verifier and becomes the recommended Google id (#980). Google released it on 2026-10-13. shared/cross_model_verification.md adds it to the supported-model table and to the provisional branch of id_status, with a note on the provider facts that touch the Gemini call pattern: Search grounding is supported, sampling parameters are ignored, and thinking_level is left at the provider default. gemini-3.1-pro-preview keeps its validated status as the previous generation. The SETUP examples (en / zh-TW) and the .claude/CLAUDE.md summary follow. No smoke or bakeoff run is claimed; scripts/cross_model_smoke_test.sh covers the OpenAI route only, so the provisional and unlisted notices for a gemini-* id no longer point to it, and § Promotion Bakeoff marks the entry gate for a Gemini candidate as pending until a Gemini smoke script ships.

  • The routing core says that a mid-message [direct-mode] token is not the escape hatch (#892). The rule was only in shared/references/intent_clarification_protocol.md, which a plugin-install session cannot read. One sentence joins Step 0 of shared/references/routing_core.md and its six copies; the academic-pipeline/SKILL.md content lock is updated. Measured on Claude Code 2.1.296 with the #133 fixtures (smoke test, one session per cell except fixture 06): on a plugin install, Claude Fable 5.1 honored the mid-message token in 6 of 6 sessions before the change and 3 of 6 after it, so the acceptance rule fixed before the run is not met and #892 stays open. All 21 fixtures ran in both installs on both models, and fixtures 13-21 ran for the first time; fixture 16 failed on Claude Opus 5.5 in the plugin install (#960), and the other single-cell failures and scoring readings are in the log. Results are in tests/fixtures/issue_133_routing/CALIBRATION_LOG.md.

  • The documentation states where the write-scope fence actually engages (#973, #974). The fence acts only when a PreToolUse payload names a Bucket A agent type, which happens for separately dispatched, named subagents. Roles that run inline in the main session carry no agent type and are not fenced. The coverage claims in the docs now say so, and captured hook payloads are pinned as test fixtures.

  • THIRD_PARTY.md lists md-to-word, a Markdown-to-DOCX typesetting companion for Stage 5 output (#969, contributed by @ls-open). It is an out-of-tree project; ARS does not bundle or endorse it.

Fixed

  • sr-screener reads a CSV export correctly when a doubled quote appears only after the first 5,000 characters (#979, reported by @paololimo). srlib.parse_csv sniffed the whole dialect from that sample, and a sample with no doubled quote switched RFC 4180 quote doubling off. A later field holding a quoted term was then split: with commas the year was lost and the DOI or journal received abstract text; with semicolons the fields stayed in place but the abstract gained stray quotes. parse_csv now sniffs only the delimiter, reads quotes by RFC 4180 (" as the quote character, doubling on), and also accepts a space before a quoted field, which RFC 4180 does not define. The same review found three related misreads, now fixed: apostrophes in the sample could make ' the quote character, a quote-free sample could split a later , "a, b" field, and a single-column export with semicolons in its titles was read as semicolon-delimited; a header record that the sniffed delimiter splits into fewer than two fields now means a single column. Six regression tests in scripts/test_sr_screener_pipeline.py cover these cases.

  • Two write-scope guard paths no longer let writes through unchecked (#972; #970 and #971 reported by @xihuheyi007). Claude Code names a plugin-shipped agent academic-research-skills:<agent>, while the scope manifest keys the bare name, so the fence never engaged for plugin-dispatched Bucket A agents; the guard now strips this plugin's own prefix before the lookup (#971). hooks/run_guard.sh trusted any timeout on PATH; the Windows built-in timeout.exe rejects the GNU form, so no Python was found and every write passed. The launcher now probes timeout once per launch and otherwise uses its watchdog fallback (#970).

  • Lints reject a non-string exception_reason (#965 by @SID-6921, #977 by @daniyyell-dev). check_field_norm_severity.py read a null reason as present through str(None) (#965). check_surface_form_parity.py treated an int, list, or bool reason as absent, so a stray typed reason on a non-exception item passed (#977).

  • Windows: the v3.6.6 A/B fixture-manifest reverse scan compares POSIX paths (#963, contributed by @SID-6921). str(Path) renders \ on Windows and missed the forward-slash manifest entries.

  • A test regex uses a raw string, removing an invalid-escape warning (#956, contributed by @SID-6921). Test-only; no behavior change.

code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v5.1.34 Stable2026-10-16T07:29:10Z

oracle, momus and plan-reviewer fall back to Argon before the previous pro model. In all three chains, Argon at high thinking (Google, Vertex or OpenCode) now sits directly ahead of the previous pro rung, which stays in place for Copilot and for engine pins that do not serve Argon yet. The GPT heads keep first place: on 8 consult and plan-review tasks graded blind, Argon beat the previous pro model in all 16 judgments but did not beat the current GPT heads on correctness, and its median answer took 57 s against 15 s. Telemetry now names the Qwen 3.7 Plus rung of explore and librarian instead of reporting it as custom. (#10180, #10263)

omo login, omo logout and omo whoami are switched off until OmO accounts open. OmO accounts aren't open to everyone yet. On every launcher (the npm omo, the compiled omo binary and the OpenCode-edition CLI), running omo login, omo logout or omo whoami, with any options including --help, prints "OmO accounts aren't available yet." and exits 1 without contacting the service or touching the OS credential store. They are gone from the OpenCode-edition CLI's --help command list, where help login, help logout and help whoami refuse the same way, and from the short command list omo --help prints when the engine can't start. Signing in to model providers (/login, omo mcp oauth login) works as before. (#10262, #10264)

omo account keys gives each machine its own device identity and keeps its private keys off the process list. omo account keys init now generates a random device id per machine and stores it with the keys, where every CLI install used to share the id cli. OMO_DEVICE_NAME no longer sets the id. On macOS without Bun.secrets, the Keychain write passes the key record to security -i on stdin; before, it went on the command line, where other processes could read it. The memory sync device keyring signs only RFC 8785 canonical JSON, checked by a full parse and re-serialization. It gains a snapshot signing purpose, and it opens epoch key wraps with the sync-design §8.1 HPKE info and associated data, so a wrap moved to another account, epoch or device does not open. Nothing syncs yet. (#10194)

Internal: an authenticated XPC transport for the desktop engine, not used yet. A hidden --xpc-agent mode serves the existing JSON-RPC over XPC. It accepts only a verified signed controller, gives each connection its own session, and carries no requests over the public discovery channel. No shipped client selects it. (#10207, #10220)

Full access no longer stops on permission prompts, and every session on a shared host can sign in the same way (senpi 2026.10.16). Under the full-access preset a configured ask rule no longer raises a prompt, while a configured deny still refuses and now names the rule and the settings layer it came from. A session opened on the shared task host lists the same sign-in options as a standalone one, so an OAuth provider that an extension registers is no longer missing there. Claude subscription sessions on 1M-window models such as Opus 5.5 no longer fail with "Prompt is too long" past 200k tokens, sessions sharing one credential pool no longer fail with "Credential store is busy", and opening the TUI or running /new without sending a message no longer leaves an empty session in /resume. The built-in Anthropic default is Opus 5.5 and the Xiaomi default is MiMo V2.6 Pro, used only when no model is saved or passed (senpi v2026.10.16, #10260)

A background child aborted by another client no longer reports a failure. Another client's user abort on a shared child session now ends that task as interrupted with whatever partial answer it had produced, instead of error: task_output keeps the partial text, no failure notification fires, and the task stays resumable with task_send. The parent's own abort still ends the task as cancelled, and provider or host-system aborts keep the failure classification (#10095).

Interrupted background tasks recover without crash warnings. Tasks that cannot reconnect resume automatically from their saved conversation and launch instructions within the existing retry budget. If recovery still fails, one notice names the task and its handle, explains why, and gives the corrective action for that cause; technical crash details stay in logs. Finished tasks with undelivered queued messages ask you to resend those messages rather than repeat finished work. Recovery completions retain partial output, the transcript tail, and a file pointer for large results (#10023, #10031).

ulw-research reports always carry visuals. The final-report phase now requires at least one chart drawn from the run's own data, a diagram wherever structure matters, and the topic's screenshots or video with attribution, every one captioned and given alt text. A new playbook says which visual fits which finding and how to render it: data charts with live text, Mermaid diagrams themed to the report, PlotNeuralNet for paper-style reports that describe a model's architecture, and Andrej Karpathy's tips on diagrams, HTML pages and explainer videos. The report checker now flags a report with no rendered visual and an image with no alt text; an empty alt counts as decorative only when the image is also marked role="presentation" or aria-hidden. (#10258, #10261)

oh-my-codex v0.21.15

0.21.15 is a patch release for the frozen range v0.21.14..38bbaab4c818cadcfe2b69de22c52cf56e670ca0 (6 commits, 39 files, +2,199/−152).

The v0.21.14 baseline already includes the single-footer correction from PR #3805 by @Yeachan-Heo.

Highlights

  • Native subagent completion and nested lifecycle routing (#3798, #3809): record native SubagentStop completion events and keep nested children associated with their tracked parent, so completion routing and deduplication continue to work through nested native subagents.
  • Bounded startup context (#3808): avoid delivering memory already present in session instructions and cap Wiki startup context at 3,500 characters while retaining complete lines and retrieval guidance.
  • Deterministic collector timing tests (#3811): inject a clock and replace wall-clock sleeps with exact latency assertions.

Compatibility

  • This continues the 0.21.x patch train. Native hook lifecycle handling is additive; existing commands and package layout are unchanged.

Validation evidence

Frozen candidate 38bbaab4c818cadcfe2b69de22c52cf56e670ca0 passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures. Local build, typecheck, and relevant test results are recorded in docs/qa/release-readiness-0.21.15.md.

career-ops-v1.37.0career-ops v1.37.0: Worth Your Time Stable2026-10-16T07:08:41Z

<!-- co:release-notes:career-ops-v1.37.0 --> This release is about knowing what is still worth your time: postings you are tracking get checked for you, and every report opens with its verdict. The dashboard work (interview prep, cover-letter drafts, row comparison) ships in web-v0.15.0.

Highlights

  • Is it still open? check-liveness.mjs --tracker checks the postings behind your open tracker rows, and --discard-expired moves the Evaluated ones that closed to Discarded when you add --apply (it is a dry run otherwise), by @mbrow190 (#5177, #5241). When you find a posting by hand that the scan missed, coverage-check explains why, by @IaroslavMazur (#4849).
  • Reports that lead with the call. Every report now opens with a Verdict block, by @rubicon (#3960). Block G gains Signal 18, recruiter identity verification, by @stdOWL (#5080), and the fact gate reads German count claims, by @duathron (#5074). Signals 8 to 17 now load only when their trigger holds, so evaluations read a shorter prompt, by @mbrow190 (#5229).
  • More places to look, in your language. A Google provider that reads the first results page only, as robots.txt allows, and an opt-in Ashby embed source, by @kellymmcgrath (#4078, #4298). Kalibrr and Tech in Asia for Southeast Asia, by @rafifshaf-fun (#4420). Platsbanken, Sweden's national job board, by @gdut4140 (#5069). preferred_languages keeps the version of a posting in the language you apply in, by @ilyakanevskiy (#5285, with #4789, #5044, #5260, #5264).
  • Your setup. Follow-ups can be turned off, by @mbrow190 (#5164). An opt-in local LaTeX installer so the LaTeX path compiles out of the box, by @CaptainCo0L (#5133). The Nix dev shell works on a fresh NixOS clone, by @asinglesprinkle (#5073).

Security

  • providers: a literal private IP host (such as http://127.0.0.1/) is now refused on the direct path too, not only behind a proxy (GHSA-jh4g-g3vm-m943). Reported by @gtyree, who also stopped the full ATS sweep from piling up thousands of idle connections in this release (#4841).

Updating

Your agent offers this update at the start of your next session. If it doesn't, run this once in your career-ops folder:

node update-system.mjs apply --confirm

Your CV, profile, tracker and reports are not touched.

Thank you

This release carries 263 pull requests from 61 people, 22 of them contributing for the first time.

desktop-v0.0.47Desktop v0.0.47 Stable2026-10-16T06:51:13Z
  • Marketplace plugins such as goal load again. In 0.0.46 they failed with Cannot find module '@cline/sdk' because the packaged app didn't include the SDK packages plugins import
  • The Cloud sessions toggle is gone from Settings. Cloud sessions are on wherever they are available
  • When a provider error interrupts a response mid-stream, Cline retries it up to 3 times before failing the turn
  • The Cline provider's default model is now Gemini 4 Argon, the new first model in Cline's recommended list
  • Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova

v4.1.25 Stable2026-10-16T06:39:24Z

Added

  • Cline Cloud sessions, rolling out gradually: run a task in a hosted sandbox on a GitHub repo and branch you pick. Turn it on in Settings. Cloud tasks show in Recent and History with their status, notify you when they finish, and keep running after you close your editor.

Changed

  • With no model chosen, the Cline provider now uses Gemini 4 Argon, the new first model in Cline's recommended list. OpenRouter stays on Claude Sonnet 5.5.
  • Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova. If you use one of those providers without pinning a model, expect a different default.

Fixed

  • Long requests to local models (LM Studio, Ollama) no longer fail after 5 minutes of silence with terminated: BodyTimeoutError while the server is still processing a large prompt.
  • OpenAI Compatible base URLs are used exactly as entered. A host-only URL like https://abc.com used to get /v1 added silently. Host-only URLs saved by earlier versions get /v1 added once, so existing setups keep working.
  • Images and files attached to an answer to one of Cline's questions now reach the model instead of being dropped.
  • When a provider error interrupts a response mid-stream, Cline retries it up to 3 times before failing the turn.
  • In JetBrains, the Run task card stays above the Auto-approve bar.
  • Auto Compact and its strategy setting sit together again in Feature settings.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/v4.1.24...v4.1.25

cli-v3.0.72CLI v3.0.72 Stable2026-10-16T05:35:42Z
  • Plugins now run in a worker instead of directly inside the hub. If this build can't run plugins, Cline says so in cline config tools, cline hub plugins, and the session-start warnings instead of quietly running them inside the hub. CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=in_process is no longer supported; use worker (the default) or sandbox
  • When a provider error interrupts a response mid-stream, Cline retries it up to 3 times before failing the turn
  • Failed model requests now log the provider's request id, which makes support tickets easier to trace
  • cline hub ensure and cline hub start gain --json (prints the hub URL and auth token), --allow-port-fallback, --no-connectors, and --login-shell-path. cline hub accepts --discovery-path to use a dedicated discovery record
  • cline hub commands no longer count as a CLI activation in usage stats
  • With no model chosen, the Cline provider now uses Gemini 4 Argon, the new first model in Cline's recommended list
  • Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova

sdk/sdk/v0.0.94SDK v0.0.94 Stable2026-10-16T03:51:13Z
  • Plugins now run only in worker threads (the default, CLINE_PLUGIN_MODE=worker) or in the subprocess sandbox (sandbox). The in_process mode is removed, along with its silent fallback. A host that ships no plugin-sandbox-bootstrap.js fails every plugin load with PluginBootstrapMissingError, which names CLINE_PLUGIN_BOOTSTRAP_PATH, instead of quietly running plugins inside the hub. The hub daemon's uncaught error handlers are fatal again. The SSH remote hub ships no bootstrap yet, so it reports plugin tools as missing
  • Provider errors that arrive after a model stream has started are retried up to 3 times, and the final failure is reported as an error in logs and Langfuse traces. Exhausted retries no longer also trigger the agent's whole-turn retry, so retry budgets don't multiply
  • Model request failure logs include the provider's request id
  • setHubDaemonLauncher lets an embedding host start the hub daemon through a bundled Cline CLI, and ensureDetachedHubServer gains a beforeSpawn hook that runs only when a new daemon actually starts. The standalone SSH remote helper entrypoint is removed: SSH remotes run the hub through the uploaded Cline CLI
  • NodeHubClient accepts resolveConnectionHeaders, so a remote proxy's WebSocket upgrade can be authenticated with HTTP headers refreshed on every reconnect. It is threaded through HubRuntimeHost and RemoteRuntimeHost
  • AskQuestionExecutor may return text and image blocks, so attachments sent with an answer reach the model
  • New buildTelemetrySelfcheckReport export in @cline/shared
  • The cline provider's bundled default (the first Cline recommended model) is now Gemini 4 Argon instead of Claude Sonnet 5.5, because the recommended list now leads with it
  • Refreshed the model catalog (6,862 → 6,952 models). Adds the Boundless and Standard Compute providers, and SambaNova now comes from the catalog with MiniMax M3 as its default. The Cline recommended list adds Gemini 4 Argon and drops Grok 4.7, and the Cline free list replaces Step 5 Preview with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL. OpenCode Go no longer lists MiniMax M2.7. Default models change for Cortecs, CrossModel, Eden AI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Google Vertex AI, LLM Gateway, Ofox, OpenCode Go, and Prime Inference (Gemini 4 Argon), Fireworks AI, Nebius Token Factory, and Requesty (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave, DigitalOcean, NanoGPT, and Nvidia (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), Aixy and Neon (Claude Haiku 5.5), Agnes AI, Ambient, IteraCompute, Poe, Scaleway, and SenseNova

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

Wei-Shaw/sub2api ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.2.17Sub2API 0.2.17 Stable2026-10-16T04:41:43Z

AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

Antigravity / Gemini 支持 Gemini 4 Argon（含计费与上游模型目录同步），Gemini 兼容入口支持思考档位与流式思考摘要；同时集中修复支付退款、易支付查单等多处资金链路问题。

新增功能

  • Gemini 4 Argon：Antigravity、Gemini API、Gemini CLI 支持 gemini-4-argon（low/medium/high），并补齐计费价格
  • Antigravity 模型目录：同步上游模型目录时按账号实际端点拉取，并保存上下文窗口、图像输入、思考等能力信息
  • Gemini 兼容入口思考档位：chat/messages 兼容入口转发 reasoning_effort / thinking 为 Gemini 思考配置，流式返回思考摘要
  • 最小输出 token 可配置：新增 gateway.min_output_tokens（默认 128，最低 16），作用于各协议转换路径
  • OpenAI API Key 账号支持 Web Search 模拟：Claude Code 走 OpenAI 分组的 /v1/messages 也可启用 web_search 模拟

优化改进

  • Vertex 共享容量不足的 429 不再冷却账号，改为同号退避重试，避免绑定显式缓存的请求直接 503
  • Vertex 服务账号已被删除时将账号置为 error 并换号，不再持续调度返回 502
  • 账号管理页恢复筛选项直接平铺展示，并优化窄屏布局

Bug 修复

  • 修复易支付（彩虹易支付 / ZPay）查单参数无法被识别、数字字符串解析失败的问题，回调确认后再入账
  • 修复退款处理中余额/订阅扣减时机问题：退款待定期间保留扣减，网关确认失败后原子回退
  • 修复支付宝退款无法查询状态的问题，查询异常保持待定、未找到记录延迟判定失败
  • 修复不支持的订单类型导致支付回调无法确认的问题，下单时校验订单类型
  • 修复 Stripe 支付页 client_secret 经 URL 传递的问题，改为从本地订单快照读取
  • 修复 GPT-5.5 退役后仍向 ChatGPT 订阅账号调度和展示该模型的问题（API Key 账号不受影响）
  • 修复 Responses 对象缺少 created_at 导致 grok-build 等客户端反序列化失败的问题
  • 修复 composite 分组模型归属歧义时 OpenAI OAuth 凭据可能误入 Anthropic 管线的问题
  • 修复自适应账号在原生 Anthropic 网关和 count_tokens 路径忽略 Anthropic 协议 base URL 的问题
  • 修复同一用户多个 Codex 工作区导入时互相覆盖的问题
  • 修复 Antigravity 丢失 tool_result 内图片、原生 Gemini functionCall/thoughtSignature，以及 composite 分组 /v1beta 路由被拒的问题
  • 修复 Antigravity Claude 5.5 档位模型按子串匹配被超额计费的问题，并保留旧版默认模型透传
  • 修复 Gemini 首次 401 在同一请求内被重复判定导致账号直接停用的问题
  • 修复智谱 GLM Coding Plan 5 小时/每周用量窗口标反的问题

破坏性变更

  • GPT-5.5 订阅退役：ChatGPT OAuth / SetupToken 账号不再调度 gpt-5.5，模型列表中也不再展示；若无可用账号，请求返回 model_not_found。API Key 账号不受影响

升级指南

  • 使用 ChatGPT 订阅账号承接 gpt-5.5 的站点，请检查账号模型映射与默认模型，将 gpt-5.5 显式映射到可用的替代模型，或改由 API Key 账号承接

📥 Installation

Docker:

# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.17

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.17

One-line install (Linux):

curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash

Manual download: Download the appropriate archive for your platform from the assets below.

stablyai/orca ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.4.227 Stable2026-10-16T03:42:35Z

Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

The short version

  • Native chats have their own permission mode. Choose permissions for each new Claude or Codex chat from Settings → Chat → Behavior; existing chats keep the mode they were already using, and changing models no longer resets it.
  • Native chat sessions are easier to continue. You can resume large terminal conversations in a new native chat, recover chats whose only work ran in the background after a restart, and see every supported chat provider accurately in Session History.
  • Claude accounts and Codex chat setup are smoother. Claude accounts again use separate folders, the sign-in link can be copied, Codex chats require version 0.136.0 or later, and Codex Ultrafast is available as a speed choice.
  • Browser automation gives your keyboard back reliably. Agent browser commands target the intended page, and browser popups behave more like Chrome.
  • Also: worktree cleanup is safer, read macOS notifications disappear from Notification Center, long chats load better on phones, and cold session-history reads avoid unnecessary reindexing.

Product experience

UI / workspace

Safer worktree cleanup, tidier macOS notifications and small translation cleanup.

  • fix(worktrees): never delete a folder git no longer tracks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25075
  • fix(notifications): remove read macOS notifications from Notification Center by pane thread by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28425
  • fix(i18n): drop chat-mode keys removed from en.json in #28113 by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28131

Orchestration

Retries no longer leave failed worker starts piling up as live agents.

  • fix(orchestration): stop retried failed worker starts from piling up live agents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27795

Agents / native chat

Each Claude and Codex chat keeps its own permission mode, chats are easier to resume and manage, Claude accounts return with safer sign-in, and chat settings and model handling are more consistent.

  • feat(native-chat): each Claude/Codex chat gets its own permission mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26116

  • feat(settings): move Permissions for new chats into the Chat page's Behavior section by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28212

Popups follow Chrome’s behavior more closely, while agent browser actions stay focused on the intended page and return the keyboard when they finish.

openclaw/openclaw ↗ 2 releases · 1 stable · 1 prerelease
v2026.10.4openclaw 2026.10.4 Stable2026-10-16T00:36:19Z

2026.10.4

Highlights

  • The Gateway keeps running after the computer sleeps or the system clock jumps, instead of restarting itself because its ownership heartbeat looked stale. (#170790) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
  • Gateway shutdown and restart no longer hang on a stalled transcript worker or in-flight session lifecycle events. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
  • Tlon group DMs no longer treat other participants as the owner, closing an owner-impersonation path. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
  • Headless browser pages keep responding to clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
  • Manual /compact settles the active run before compacting instead of aborting it and dropping the pending request. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.

Changes

  • Stability patch for 2026.10.3 with no new features or configuration changes. Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Gateway: stays responsive during long reply-tagged streams, and long replies that quote tool-call XML no longer re-parse Markdown on every token. (#166782, #171573) Thanks @boeingchoco.
  • Gateway: blocked durable context-engine turns are logged once instead of on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Control UI: delayed application heartbeats no longer force a reconnect. (#171253)
  • Gateway: recover state ownership after sleep and wall-clock changes, and allow openclaw gateway restart from verified external macOS terminals. (#170790, #170354) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
  • Gateway: bound transcript-worker shutdown waits and wait for session lifecycle publication during shutdown. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
  • Gateway: start enabled standalone plugin files with the Gateway, and keep worker heap limits enforced when the managed service sets a process-wide heap flag. (#171330, #166581) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, @waynegault, and @obviyus.
  • Agents: launched plugin turns no longer fail with writer-claim errors, and Claude CLI sessions no longer fork history across message routes. (#170077, #167241) Thanks @cmatrx0.
  • Agents: manual compaction settles the active run instead of aborting it. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.
  • OpenAI: tool turns for reasoning models on api.openai.com Completions routes no longer fail with a 400. (#166182) Thanks @obviyus and @AsTutoAI.
  • Updates: agent databases are no longer flagged as changed during snapshot capture, the success summary stops repeating settled plugin data/settings upgrades as pending, and metadata inventory keeps running under progress-output backpressure. (#170351, #170413, #168493) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Updates: slow host admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, progress keeps reporting through temporary Doctor maintenance, snapshot failures get an accurate headline and recovery advice, and Linux updates can clean up abandoned runtime directories under protected systemd user managers. (#171493, #171454, #171457, #171488, #170783, #166335) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @vincentkoc.
  • Updates: candidate validation no longer amplifies private SQLite snapshots on live installs, older drivers stop reading candidate-migrated state and stale restart verdicts clear, and optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer stall updates. (#167451, #170130, #170754) Thanks @angeliti999 and @RomneyDa.
  • Updates: openclaw update repair turns no longer time out before running tools on slower hosts; nested authority checks reuse the current state snapshot instead of copying the database again. (#166847)
  • Doctor: updates no longer refuse unreferenced retired OAuth sidecars, and offline state repair works for app-owned Gateways. (#165420, #170768) Thanks @obviyus and @RomneyDa.
  • Tailscale: an interrupted start stops its serve process, local access stays available when the tailnet denies Serve, and Doctor checks configured Tailscale startup prerequisites. (#167514, #171509, #166947) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
  • macOS: app recovery keeps compatible newer Gateways instead of downgrading them, and repair accepts a verified LaunchAgent bootstrap that is already in progress. (#170766, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Sessions: equivalent POSIX path aliases such as /tmp and /private/tmp no longer restart channels. (#166462) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star.
  • MCP: OAuth login completes when the authorization server registers loopback redirect URIs without a port. (#170876) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art.
  • Browser: headless pages accept clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
  • Control UI: updated chats recover through the serving document. (#168941)
  • Tlon: never treat group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
  • Telegram: polling workers resolve in both source and package builds. (#154286) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui and @markfietje.
  • Discord: agent consults keep working after voice changes. (#171029) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star and @brainmonger.
  • Feishu: config hot-reload no longer orphans conversation bindings. (#169226) Thanks @ruel225, @junniar, and @obviyus.
  • IRC: long non-ASCII replies are no longer lost when the server relays them. (#159730) Thanks @rodricksz4h5.
  • Release: plugin npm publish tolerates repeated artifact pagination entries, Linux builds trigger after automatic requests with hosted-runner credentials, and ratchet checks read large Git baselines. (#171044, #167087, #167237, #164743) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

2026.10.10-beta.1

Highlights

  • Faster, steadier Gateway: chat turns, session lists, startup, and idle Gateways do far less SQLite and main-thread work, with more database work moved onto worker threads, so busy hosts and large agent fleets stay responsive. (#167965, #168002, #168093, #169005, #169164, #171685, #170151, #169871, #168649, #170612, #171371, #171805, #168992, #169543) Thanks @obviyus, @609NFT, @Leon-SK668, @chelsealong, @RomneyDa, and @joshavant.
  • Updates that finish: upgrades from 2026.10.1 and earlier betas complete, busy Gateways and slow Doctor steps no longer refuse or roll back a good update, failed updates no longer leave a half-installed version, and macOS, Windows, and Bun installs recover from their platform-specific failures. (#168849, #172249, #172196, #172151, #172247, #171101, #170519, #172640, #171936, #170940, #171077, #172494) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @giulianoaccorsi, @AntaresGG, @stop-time, @davidcittadini, and @SBC2016.
  • Restart-safe replies: interrupted and unfinished replies resume after a Gateway restart, and watched child results, queued turns, accepted agent updates, and operator tasks survive restarts instead of disappearing. (#172234, #172412, #169489, #171717, #170697, #170858, #170384, #172356, #172023) Thanks @jeanmonet.
  • Cloud sessions: move sessions between local and cloud from the session menu, organize cloud environments by repository with environment recipes and verified Node toolchains, and see snapshot progress while sessions start before the first snapshot finishes uploading. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729)
  • Local Gateway in the desktop apps: the Windows desktop app and fresh Tauri installs can run a local Gateway, fresh macOS installs start in guided dashboard setup, and first-run setup chooses inference automatically. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169628)
  • New models: Gemini 4 Argon becomes the default Gemini model alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and xAI Imagine Image 2.0 arrive, Meta models run through Muse Code, and pickers stop offering retired models. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170487, #171526, #171879) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, and @obviyus.
  • Newer Apple platforms required: OpenClaw now requires macOS 26.2, iOS 26.2, and Safari 26.2 or newer. (#168595)

Changes

  • Apple platform requirement: require macOS, iOS, and Safari 26.2 or newer for the native apps and Control UI. (#168595)
  • Cloud sessions: move sessions between local and cloud from session menus, organize cloud environments by repository, support repository environment recipes with verified Node toolchains, save suggested cloud profiles on first use, show snapshot startup progress, start sessions while the first snapshot uploads, ready workers for empty-workspace sessions, report slow dispatch phases, and keep cloud setup secrets behind scoped egress grants. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729, #170929, #171749, #171073, #170810) Thanks @VACInc.
  • Desktop apps and first run: support local Gateways in the Windows desktop app, start fresh Tauri installs with a local Gateway, start fresh macOS installs in guided dashboard setup, guide missing native permissions in chat, and choose inference automatically during first-run setup. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169635, #169628)
  • Local setup: offer optional memory embedding setup, add managed llama.cpp OCR and vision setup, and allow non-interactive llama.cpp embedding-only setup. (#163693, #148193, #170153) Thanks @PollyBot13, @duyufansh2008, and @dh-js.
  • Bun runtime: build standalone OpenClaw executables with Bun, add an opt-in pinned Bun runtime that rejects unpinnable paths before changing anything, and start the Gateway faster on Bun. (#172384, #168832, #168982, #169543) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Experimental PostgreSQL: add an experimental PostgreSQL engine for the Workboard store, select the shared-state engine at its owner, generate PostgreSQL DDL from canonical SQLite schemas, add PostgreSQL migrations with capability admission and exact schema-drift checks, preserve PostgreSQL stores in backups and updates, and add verified offline database port tooling. (#169214, #171962, #168219, #169933, #172265, #170828, #170518, #171368, #171265, #170037, #170055, #170059, #171350, #171484, #171518, #171795, #172046, #171545) Thanks @vincentkoc and @joshavant.
  • Conversations: organize and archive nested conversations explicitly, choose when sessions can send and receive messages, opt in to sessions_send thread targets, run sessions in existing folders on paired devices, and snooze sessions until a custom time. (#168076, #162316, #168846, #169722, #171255) Thanks @VACInc, @obviyus, and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Session personalization: personalize session backgrounds, add per-session speech bubbles and prompt reactions, show session-specific previews for public links, and match public conversation pages to the chat design with copy buttons. (#168301, #168861, #169527, #168156) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @VACInc.
  • Control UI navigation: organize personal navigation in a compact sidebar rail with real shortcut icons, filter sidebar users by online status, keep New conversation visible across sidebar modes, show session details beside wide conversations, make colored sessions easier to scan, inspect attached automations from session hovercards, put everyday session actions first, and make release updates discoverable from the account menu. (#168325, #168997, #172243, #170771, #170707, #170382, #172240, #168616, #172544, #100024) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @shakkernerd, and @VACInc.
  • Control UI chat: group session context and task progress in Details, clarify the session details inspector, render assistant directives and an embed tag, show readable tweet preview cards, load older history in larger pages, shrink the composer in existing sessions, search emoji by name in the reaction picker, add manual code folding to session diffs, and show or hide values in secure entry prompts. (#161674, #172436, #64104, #168213, #170481, #171637, #172577, #172350, #169925, #172549) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, @Takhoffman, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Languages: add Swedish to the Control UI and docs, and include plugin catalogs in locale refresh. (#62063, #171496) Thanks @yeager and @vincentkoc.
  • Agents API: choose Agents API hosted workspaces when starting sessions, isolate Agents API sessions from Gateway tools and MCP, and allow shared compaction tuning in hosted sessions. (#168259, #170728, #171813)
  • MCP apps and automations: use MCP plugin apps across conversations and workspace files, trigger automations from MCP events, connect MCP apps through a principal-bound relay plugin, and support principal-bound remote Control UI for trusted plugins. (#161747, #165399, #168233, #170540)
  • Plugins and SDK: allow per-run model fallback overrides, fork a session's live context for background side questions, let plugins steer a session's active run, support Solid Control UI views, add worker-owned keyed state and conversation binding APIs, join service and account scheduling at retirement, complete awaited SQLite compatibility migration paths, and show calm notices for deprecated SDK usage. (#168893, #170146, #170152, #168408, #168478, #168483, #162669, #171443, #171752) Thanks @obviyus, @dwty11, and @joshavant.
  • ClawHub: expose published ClawHub packages to the Gateway and accept portable manifest categories. (#171622, #171532) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Models and providers: add Gemini 4 Argon as the default Gemini model with Gemini 3.8 Flash, replace Nemotron 3 Super with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, add xAI Imagine Image 2.0 without silent image-model fallback, accept the Fish Audio Drama 3 preview, support endpoint-resolved custom model aliases, prefer a newer installed Codex for ChatGPT discovery, and prioritize shared private vLLM requests. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170473, #170009, #168228, #129434) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, @xyrolle, @obviyus, @m888m, and @joshavant.
  • Muse Code: run Meta models through the Muse Code CLI agent runtime, sign in to Muse Code from Model Setup and Provider Access, and run consented turns under a conversation tool policy. (#170487, #171526, #171790, #172361) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Usage and accounts: show active auth subscription blocks, show Ollama cloud balance in status usage, add a ClawRouter sidebar dashboard for subscription pool headroom, show local provider processing with estimated wait time, and show every matched session in a paged usage overview. (#133087, #167474, #169514, #170041, #170369, #169660) Thanks @Leon-SK668, @vincentkoc, and @usimic.
  • Model recovery: use model fallbacks after context-overflow recovery, compact ChatGPT sign-in sessions server-side, end runs after confirmed final source replies, and support typed OpenAI Decisions API evaluations. (#170141, #168401, #170653, #166320) Thanks @amirarenco-create, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @sunlit-deng, @jjjhenriksen, and @Kimiyu-186.
  • Labs Advisor: add an experimental Advisor that steers agents away from avoidable work. (#169564) Thanks @obviyus.
  • CLI progress: show progress while tool input is generated. (#167789) Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, and @umeranjum17.
  • Skills: show a Learned notice row with one-press Undo, make background review channel notices opt-in, and save only repeatable procedures from background reviews. (#167996, #170025, #170277) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Clearer messages: simplify wording across Settings, Gateway and security diagnostics, CLI and Doctor, agent and command execution, browser and approval help, provider, messaging, workspace, and memory plugins, and the macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux apps. (#168703, #168704, #168705, #168706, #168707, #168709, #168710, #168711, #168713, #168714, #168715, #168716) Thanks @RomneyDa, @synthalorian, and @obviyus.
  • Mobile and devices: add Android system, photos, contacts, calendar, and motion capabilities, add an authenticated iOS background presence beacon, and support multiple Microsoft Teams bot accounts. (#29398, #73330, #112811) Thanks @obviyus and @jimmypuckett.
  • Worker placement: require configured worker placement for sessions and allow keyless Gateway selection for worker-local inference. (#158903, #170132) Thanks @sallyom, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Diagnostics: export turn prompts and final answers on message and run spans, attribute GC metrics by kind and worker, measure allocated bytes per RPC and turn, attribute native CPU samples to JavaScript callers, capture main-thread stall stacks, and expose SQLite worker delay phases. (#156603, #171923, #172486, #171686, #170904, #169535, #170932, #171082, #171062) Thanks @ryan-dyer-sp, @vincentkoc, and @joshavant.

  • Workers: enforce worker heap limits under process-wide flags, isolate delegated worker transcript ownership, finish worker shutdown after inventory retirement, release cancelled node-host invocations, archive sessions after orphaned worker cleanup, and close async cleanup gaps.
