can1357/oh-my-pi ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v18.11.1 Stable2026-10-15T15:02:20Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Added

  • Tokenizer.countLatestTurn: counts a message as the transcript's latest assistant turn, which an Anthropic Messages replay keeps byte-for-byte (#15791 by @will-bogusz)
  • Agent.prioritizeSteering: moves given pending steering messages ahead of older ones so one-at-a-time delivery takes them first (#15642)

Fixed

  • Fixed a Cursor tool call re-sent by the server persisting two results under one id; the re-run's result replaces the first (#15749)
  • Fixed compaction keeping more recent history than keepRecentTokens when the latest Claude turn on the Anthropic Messages API ended its tool calls on stop or length: the replay keeps that turn's signed reasoning, but the cut point counted only its visible blocks (#15791 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added

  • Added image support for native OpenAI Decisions and Workers AI judgments, prompted vision chat, and auth-gateway System One requests; images exceeding a judgment API's documented caps (e.g. Clef's 4 images, 4 MiB each) are rejected locally (#15471 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • isSurvivingAssistant in providers/transform-messages: whether an assistant turn reaches a replay, malformed tool calls dropped first, so callers outside transformMessages pick the same latest turn (#15791 by @will-bogusz)

Fixed

  • Fixed Codex-hosted image generation ignoring the requested aspect_ratio/image_size, and 3:2/2:3 requests sending no size to OpenAI image models (#15601 by @chulmin-dev)
  • Fixed Claude subagents failing to return structured results when yield arguments arrived as invalid JSON (#15605 by @farnoy)
  • Fixed turns stopping instead of retrying when a gateway reports its upstream WebSocket closed before response.completed (#15628 by @nqrwhal).
  • Fixed Claude on Google Vertex ignoring cacheRetention: "long": prompt caches now get the 1h TTL instead of expiring after 5 minutes, and the extended-cache-ttl beta (which Vertex rejects) is never sent there (#15505 by @hpost)
  • Fixed Gemini tool continuations failing on OpenAI-compatible gateways that return reasoning_signature, including restored sessions (#15678 by @Zzz141592653)
  • Fixed Cursor sessions failing every rebuilt request with PROVIDER_ERROR after the server re-sent a tool call: the call is recorded once, and histories that already repeat it replay it once with its latest result (#15749)
  • Fixed Cursor turns cut off mid-stream failing every retry with PROVIDER_ERROR until you sent a new message; the retry now starts a fresh Cursor conversation (#15830)
  • Fixed malformed image-generation inputs being forwarded to providers or reported as credential/upstream errors (#15765 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • Fixed broker-backed auth-gateway processes retaining a cache entry for every distinct client session indefinitely under sustained traffic (#15841).
  • Fixed turns ending on a pinned error when a provider reports "temporarily unavailable" or finishes with an unknown, other or unspecified finish reason: these now retry automatically (#15424 by @lockwo)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Fixed

  • Enabled long prompt-cache retention (ttl: "1h") for Claude models on google-vertex (#15505 by @hpost)
  • Fixed Gemini 4 Argon on Google Vertex and the Gemini API failing every request with "Thinking budget is not supported for this model": Gemini 4 now sends thinkingLevel instead of thinkingBudget, and Argon offers only the low, medium, and high levels Google accepts (#15643 by @kevcube)
  • Fixed the Antigravity model selector offering roster rows the backend marks disabled (disabled: true, e.g. gemini-4-argon-disabled on accounts without Argon access), which answered Cloud Code Assist API error (404): Requested entity was not found.; discovery now skips them the way it already skips isInternal rows (#15684 by @CharleoYang)
  • Removed Google Antigravity's Gemini 3.5 Flash and its gemini-3-flash alias from the model list; Antigravity retired them and answers every request with a retirement notice instead of a reply (#15445 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed xai-oauth Grok 4.20 models (grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, -non-reasoning, grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309) advertising a 2M context window when the SuperGrok API rejects prompts over 1M; auto-compaction and context usage now work from the 1M window (#15443 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed trailing-dot localhost. and *.local. custom endpoints losing local-backend compatibility settings (#15798).

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Added image attachments to single and batch eval judge()/judge_batch() calls (local paths or embedded images); image judgments skip candidates without image support and fail explicitly instead of dropping images (#15471 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Added a job tree to /jobs, /jobs full and the jobs pill's sheet, in the terminal UI and over ACP: subagents' background jobs now appear nested under the task that runs them, with the busiest branches listed first; only your own jobs offer Cancel (#15854 by @H4vC)
  • Added ctx.ui.getEditorComponent() so extensions can wrap the active custom editor factory instead of replacing it (#8655 by @jovi-tsx)

Changed

  • Reduced memory used by bundled model catalog data in standalone and npm installs (#15876 by @iliaal).

Fixed

  • Fixed /shake and automatic shake leaving old transcript rows in native scrollback or obscuring the start of a response beside the Todo HUD (#15877).
  • Fixed write making Rust source files beginning with #![...] executable instead of preserving their permissions (#15858).
  • Fixed the startup status bar preview showing a previous session's model instead of the default model (#15865).
  • Fixed length-stop recovery with a lowered compaction.thresholdTokens counting the discarded output against the threshold, so a reasoning-only cut compacted without the retry hint and a truncated answer was discarded instead of kept (#15870)
  • Fixed read on a directory showing (empty directory) when the directory itself is unreadable, and silently omitting subdirectories it cannot list; it now errors for an unreadable root and marks unreadable subdirectories [unreadable: …] (#15769).
  • Fixed isolated tasks losing the commits of a submodule added inside the isolation, leaving the merged checkout pinned to an unreachable commit (#15459)
  • Fixed isolated task startup hanging or detaching an unrelated checkout when .gitmodules lists a submodule path that is absolute or contains ./.. (#15459)
  • Fixed /live and Ctrl+L starting live mode while the composer microphone was still loading its recognizer, which opened a second recorder and dictated into the hidden editor (#15759)
  • Fixed images in the transcript not opening their file; their placeholders and image chips now link to it (#15872 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed print mode returning success after length-stop recovery gave up; it now waits for the session to settle before choosing its exit code (#15732 by @nick-maderight)
  • Fixed browser tab.click("text/…") passing over a match a scroll container shows only a narrow strip of and clicking a later duplicate instead (#15792 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed /advisor status waiting on usage checks; it now renders immediately with cached quota data and refreshes usage in the background (#15780 by @mvid)
  • Fixed task agents silently skipping autoload-skills entries for skills added after the session started (#15723 by @shyamsivakumar)
  • Fixed changed initOptions in lsp.json not applying when a new session reused an idle shared language server (#15645 by @mottopanikeiku; #15535)
  • Fixed wake completions falsely reporting no output when the agent already messaged its owner over IRC (#15834 by @mg-mg-mg).
  • Fixed a steered service readiness wait leaving the daemon broker polling until ready.timeout; the abandoned wait is now cancelled (#15656)
  • Fixed Cursor ;-separated reads returning an image part's bytes as text (#15635)
  • Fixed auto-compaction ignoring retry.waitForUsageReset and abandoning the last compaction method on a provider-stated usage-limit reset past retry.maxDelayMs (#15313)
  • Fixed advisor compaction dropping the kept latest turn when the native compaction had to stop before it (#15712)
  • Fixed tool-approval steering: a message typed while viewing a subagent now steers the main session awaiting the approval, the message that denied a call is delivered ahead of older queued steers, and an equal-looking later steer no longer answers a new approval (#15642)
  • Fixed workpool item errors cancelling the entire batch; workers now continue with remaining items and report each result separately (#15860).
  • Fixed image attachments with uppercase MIME types being dropped; supported image MIME types are now matched case-insensitively (#15765 by @anatoli-tsinovoy)
  • Fixed ordinary Bash commands emitting an ignored-readiness warning for placeholder-only ready fields, while preserving warnings for log/port conditions and service validation (#15629 by @nqrwhal).
  • openai-models-list discovery reads the output limit from top_provider.max_completion_tokens (OpenRouter-shaped catalogs such as ModelRelay), so a bundled reference with a larger limit no longer makes requests the provider rejects (#15652 by @shanev)
  • Fixed saved session history being replaced by incomplete rewrites after asynchronous disk write failures (#15588 by @jiwangyihao).
  • Fixed the read tool description inviting :img on PNG paths: it now says :img only rasterizes SVG/SVGZ files and raster images need no selector, and the :img error on a raster file says to read it without the selector (#15671 by @nick-maderight)
  • Corrected the ast_grep truncated-result advice to suggest skip pagination or narrowing instead of increase limit, which the tool schema does not accept (#15532, #15543 by @peda-cos).
  • Fixed Cursor sessions with many MCP tools compacting unnecessarily or pausing automatic maintenance despite ample free context (#15815).
  • Fixed switching a session or advisor to Cursor still counting the previous model's tool schemas toward context usage and compaction (#15815).
  • Fixed todo reminders continuing the agent when the todo tool is disabled (#12589 by @anthonyrisinger).
  • Fixed JS eval completion() handles created in one cell never resolving in a later cell, which left wait(handles, { timeout }) hanging past its timeout (#15756).
  • Closed read :raw line ranges now return only the requested content, and newline-terminated files report their actual line count (#15810).
  • Fixed /review PR file assignments by including exact per-file diff URLs and preserving 1-based indexes across excluded files (#15463 by @tkossak)
  • Fixed grep and ast_grep returning no matches for a path glob that names directories, such as src/{api,web} or src/we?; matched directories are now searched recursively like a plain directory path, so src/* also searches files in src's subdirectories (#15760)
  • Fixed a structured display() value in an Eval cell appearing twice in the TUI and collab view, as text in the cell box and again as the JSON tree; it now shows once, as the tree, while the model still sees the text (#10778, #12730 by @F0Rextasy)
  • omp auth-gateway serve now bounds its broker-backed session cache instead of growing with every distinct client session (#15841).
  • Fixed the run ending when a reasoning model stops with only a signed thinking block and no reasoning text (seen with Gemini 4 via OpenRouter); the agent now continues it like any other thinking-only stop (#15837)
  • Fixed openai-models-list discovery ignoring a model's top-level max_output_tokens / max_completion_tokens, which let gateway models inherit an output cap as large as the whole context window and send oversized max_completion_tokens (#15811)
  • Fixed the standalone binary crashing with Settings not initialized when resuming or starting a TUI session with an extension whose dependencies clear require.cache (e.g. request-promise via pi-messenger-bridge) (#15799)
  • Python Eval displays preserve integers outside JavaScript's safe range as decimal strings in structured JSON instead of silently rounding them (#15847).
  • Loop-watchdog stalls while Mnemopi truncates the recall query for compaction or background first-turn recall are now logged under mnemopi.recall instead of unknown (#15413 by @jaredlyon).
  • Clarified the /session pin description: it pins a stored OAuth account to the current provider for this session only (#15479 by @iacore)
  • Fixed /jobs doing nothing in a focused subagent view: it now lists that subagent's own background jobs, as does the jobs pill's sheet, without a way to cancel them; /jobs kill still requires returning to the main session (#15161 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed a suspended JavaScript Eval cell resolving artifact:// and local:// paths against the session directories of another cell that started while it was awaiting (#15409 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed read ignoring JSON and JSONL ?q= filters and pagination for local:// and artifact:// files (#15767).
  • Agents can now read saved context notes without accidentally clearing them (#15748 by @Komzpa)
  • Fixed startup without an explicit model picking an unrelated authenticated provider instead of the first available model in the configured default fallback chain (#15781 by @mvid)

@oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

Fixed

  • Fixed a failing mnemopi CLI command or MCP memory call dropping the embeddings of memories it had just stored (#15804 by @yuzu-octopus)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Added

  • Added listWorkspace({ reportDirectoryErrors }): an unreadable root fails the scan and unreadable subdirectories are returned in unreadableDirectories instead of being silently skipped (#15769).

Fixed

  • Fixed unnecessary worker scheduling overhead in read loops over regular files (#15504 by @mg-mg-mg)
  • Fixed astGrep and astEdit missing parse errors when Tree-sitter recovered by inserting a missing token, so edits could rewrite files that do not parse; such files are now reported and skipped (#15530, #15851 by @glyahh)
  • Fixed grep and astGrep glob filters skipping the files under a directory the glob matches, so {src,test} or sr? found nothing; a matched directory now selects every file under it, so dir/* also matches files in dir's subdirectories (#15760)
  • Fixed grep() and search() showing the start of a line wider than maxColumns, with no column, when the only match was an empty one at the end of the file ($ or \z on a last line without a newline); they now show the end of the line and its column (#15411 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed embedded-shell xargs failing with "Argument list too long" on large input lists instead of splitting them into executable batches (#15708 by @mg-mg-mg)
  • Fixed applying a submodule pin patch to the worktree failing with "does not exist" for a submodule directory or trying to write the pinned commit as a file; like git apply, the submodule's checkout is left untouched, an added pin creates its empty directory, and a removed one deletes only an empty (uninitialized) directory (#15459)
  • Fixed diffText/numstat showing a moved submodule as a delete plus an add instead of Git's 100% rename, and applyPatch now applies such rename patches (#15459)
  • Fixed submodulePaths() following .gitmodules paths that are absolute or contain ./.., which could point outside the repository or loop forever; like Git, such entries are ignored (#15459)
  • Fixed copyGitObjects exposing partially copied objects and packs to concurrent Git readers and permanently skipping a file truncated by an interrupted copy; each file is now published atomically (#15459)
  • Fixed embedded-shell read in a pipeline stage or async job queueing a second blocking worker while holding its own, which could hang every such read once the bounded blocking pool filled (#15509)
  • Fixed Mermaid labels decoding legacy references such as &#128; or #150; to invisible C1 controls instead of the browser's € and – (#15621)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added

  • Added a tree layout to the background jobs sheet: subagents' jobs nest under the task job that runs them, busiest branches first, and Cancel appears only on the viewing agent's own jobs (#15854 by @H4vC)

Fixed

  • Fixed transcript images not opening their file: image placeholders and native image nodes now link to the source file or a stored copy (#15872 by @H4vC)
  • A collapsing live block no longer leaves its slack as a band of blank rows between the retired history and the live rows: the slack falls below the transcript, so a streamed reply stays contiguous and the input keeps the bottom row (#15499 by @iacore)
  • Fixed width-aware text on native (TSP) terminals truncating content two columns early (#15806 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed Tab/right-arrow completion silently dismissing a selected @"quoted path" file suggestion when the path contains spaces (#15698 by @drawde-nadroj)
  • Bracketed pastes are now capped by their UTF-8 size, so a large multibyte paste no longer buffers past the byte limit (#15803 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Fixed OSC 66 text-sized spans bypassing truncation when their UTF-16 length was short enough to fit the fast-path guard (#15802 by @yuzu-octopus)
  • Updated the ast_grep result view's truncated-match note to suggest skip pagination instead of the schema's nonexistent increase limit flag (#15532, #15543 by @peda-cos).
  • Fixed a streaming Edit preview with long wrapped lines growing past its row cap, because its tail was budgeted without the diff gutter its continuation rows hang under (#15679)
  • Fixed malformed base64 padding being accepted for chat image attachments before native image decoding (#15765 by @anatoli-tsinovoy).
  • Fixed Shift+Enter submitting and Ctrl+Enter inserting a newline in Windows Terminal 1.25–1.27 after closing any fullscreen view such as /settings; the terminal dropped omp's keyboard mode on leaving the alternate screen (microsoft/terminal#20763), so omp now re-applies it (#15868 by @H4vC).
  • Long lines in native (Tern) read, write, and code-cell source now wrap instead of scrolling each block sideways (#15823).
  • Fixed long text pastes taking seconds to land in terminals that deliver a paste one key at a time, such as JetBrains' terminal on Windows; omp no longer writes to the terminal for every pasted key (#15757)
  • Fixed Shift+Enter submitting the prompt and Ctrl+Enter inserting a newline in WSL under Windows Terminal 1.24 and earlier, conhost, and other ConPTY hosts without kitty keyboard support; Shift+Enter now inserts a newline and Ctrl+Enter sends a follow-up, as on native Windows.
  • Fixed streamed Markdown tables jumping around as each row arrives: the terminal UI fills the row being written in under the existing column widths, and native (TSP) terminals receive each row once its line is complete (#15856 by @H4vC).
  • Fixed streamed links and inline math showing raw [text](url or LaTeX and then rewrapping the paragraph when they close, in the terminal UI and native (TSP) terminals: they now render in their closed form while they stream (#15864 by @H4vC).
  • Paint-only overlays no longer swallow typing intended for the focused input beneath them (#15793).
